dependency_note: Catalog depends on WFA-0112 (benchmark case corpus), which is absent. Scoring runs against bundled recorded-run fields that match the harness record shape. This demonstrates the rubric, not an estate-corpus harvest.

evidence.claim: Correctness, coverage, recovery and usability are ratios over recorded oracle/attempt/retry/telemetry fields with the formula string stored next to the number.
Matched intersection c01-c06; asymmetric unique solves c07-c09 on fusion_complement are excluded from the head-to-head correctness denominator.
Low-agreement kappa=-1.0 removes human_usability_rating; high-agreement kappa=1.0 would retain it. Removal, not a caveat or a down-weight.

freeze.rule: The spec hash is taken before the first certification decision. Changing a formula after freeze REFUSES.

inter_rater.frozen_human_component: removed from the production rubric because the honest calibration set is the low-agreement pair; high-agreement is the both-states control

high_agreement.formula: mean of two raters' 0-4 scores / 4, retained only when Cohen's kappa on the paired ratings is >= 0.75; otherwise REMOVED, not down-weighted.

low_agreement.formula: mean of two raters' 0-4 scores / 4, retained only when Cohen's kappa on the paired ratings is >= 0.75; otherwise REMOVED, not down-weighted.
low_agreement.reason: cohen_kappa=-1.0000 below floor 0.75; removed not weighted down

question: Implementation target: a scoring rubric with computed - not judged - components for correctness, coverage, recovery and usability, and an explicit rule for what counts as materially complementary when a fused workflow does not outperform its sources.

reviewers.requirement: re-run both-states: complement vs padded-stages, and high vs low inter-rater

formulas.coverage: n_attempted / n_matched on the same matched intersection. Distinct from correctness: an arm can attempt every case and still fail them.
formulas.human_usability_rating: mean of two raters' 0-4 scores / 4, retained only when Cohen's kappa on the paired ratings is >= 0.75; otherwise REMOVED, not down-weighted.
formulas.material_complementarity: |solved(fusion) minus union(solved(sources))| / |corpus|. Material when delta >= 0.10 and at least one unique solve. Unique solves are NEVER added to the head-to-head composite.
